name: Harvest
summary: Harvest has a free plan for one person and two projects, a Teams plan at $9 per seat a month and Enterprise at $14 on annual billing. On its Flex billing, usage charges for projects, clients, tasks and invoicing come on top of seats. Timesheet approval is on Enterprise only.

evidence.capability: time entry or clock in and out

facts.text: On Flex billing, Harvest charges per seat plus usage fees for active projects, clients, tasks and invoicing above a free allowance. For new accounts, usage charges start at the second paid renewal.
Harvest's help center gives the example of a bill rising from $44 for seats alone to $404 once usage is added, and offers Unlimited billing at a fixed usage fee as the alternative.
Harvest states that timesheets cannot be rejected. A manager who wants changes messages the person to edit and resubmit.
Harvest relies on its hosting provider's SOC 2 audit rather than a report of its own, and stores all data in the United States.
The Gusto integration syncs approved timesheets and reimbursable expenses for payroll, for US businesses only.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: Billed annually ($108 a year); $11 on monthly billing. Usage charges extra on Flex billing

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Billed annually ($168 a year); $17.50 on monthly billing. Adds timesheet approval and SAML single sign-on

hiddenCosts: On Flex billing, active projects, clients, tasks and invoicing above a free allowance are charged on top of seats. The allowance and unit prices are shown in the account, not on the pricing page.
Unlimited billing replaces usage charges with a fixed fee that is not published on the pricing page.

contract.cancellation: No refund or credit for fees already paid; Harvest gives 30 days' notice of fee changes.
contract.dataExport: All time data as one CSV file, detailed reports as Excel, CSV or PDF, and invoices as a zip of PDFs.
